title: Keyboard differences between Windows and Macs
summary: A practical guide explaining the key differences between Windows and Mac keyboards, including modifier key layouts, shortcut conventions, and ergonomic variations that users encounter when switching between platforms.
problem_solved: Helps users understand keyboard layout and shortcut differences when working across both Windows and Mac systems.
why_valuable: Reduces friction and learning curve for users transitioning between Windows and Mac, improving productivity in multi-platform environments.
